title: 10+ Free AI tools for 2026 | Google Cloud
summary:
Here is the combined summary in the requested format:

MAIN POINTS:
- Google AI Studio offers free usage of many AI products, including Translation, Speech-to-Text, Natural Language, and Video Intelligence.
- Free usage limit does not expire but is subject to change.
- Core generative AI tools offer defined free usage: Google AI Studio, NotebookLM, Gemini Code Assist for individuals.
- Google Gemini is free to use for users 18+ with a personal Google Account or Google Workspace account.

IMPORTANT FACTS:
- The free plans and pricing details are as follows:
	+ Agent-first IDE: unlimited tab completions and command requests, with access to leading agent models (subject to weekly rate limits).
	+ Command-line interface: up to 1,000 model requests per day with Google account authentication or up to 250 requests per day with unpaid API key.
	+ Code Assist: high usage limits including up to 180,000 code completions per month.
	+ NotebookLM: 100 notebooks, 50 sources per notebook, and a source capacity of up to 500,000 words per source.
	+ Translation: first 500,000 characters free per month.
	+ Face detection: first 1,000 units free per month.
	+ Speech-to-text: first 60 minutes free per month.
	+ Text-to-speech: first 4 million characters (Standard) or first 1 million characters (WaveNet) free per month.
	+ Sentiment analysis: first 5,000 units free per month.
	+ Video detection: first 1,000 minutes free per month.
	+ Virtual machines: 1 non-preemptible e2-micro VM instance in US regions free per month.
	+ Storage: 5 GiB of US regional storage free per month.

INSIGHTS:
- Google Cloud offers free usage of over 20 products, including 10 free AI tools, up to monthly limits.
- Key features include Translation API Basic and Advanced, Cloud Vision AI, Vision API, Speech-to-Text API, Text-to-Speech API, Natural Language API, Video Intelligence API, NotebookLM, and more.
